# LocalPilot

> {{ site.description }}

LocalPilot is a free, MIT-licensed Visual Studio Code extension (`{{ site.extension_id }}`, version {{ site.version }}). It is a complete coding agent — agent / ask / plan modes, parallel agents with change review, skills and subagents, @-mentions and workspace context, screenshots and vision models, inline completions and MCP servers — that runs entirely against local model servers such as Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM and Docker Model Runner (or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint). It can set models up by itself: with no model found it installs or starts Ollama and downloads a smallest-first starter set sized to the machine's RAM/GPU; a model manager shows what fits, enables/disables/removes installed models and installs from a curated catalog; automatic routing sends image turns to a vision model, completions to the smallest FIM model and falls back when a model is offline. No account, no telemetry, no code leaves the machine unless the user configures a remote endpoint. It is a private, offline alternative to GitHub Copilot, Cursor and Claude Code. It also reuses existing CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, .cursor/rules, .claude/skills, .claude/agents and .github/copilot-instructions.md files.

Install: VS Code Marketplace {{ site.marketplace }} or `code --install-extension {{ site.extension_id }}`. VSIX downloads: {{ site.releases }}. Source: {{ site.repo }}. Author: {{ site.author.name }} ({{ site.author.url }}).
